svg.title: IFINDIT SEARCH: answers across connected sources
svg.desc: IFINDIT SEARCH illustration: a person asks “How many contracts did we sign with IT suppliers in 2025?” and the search engine answers directly that 48 contracts were signed, citing a spreadsheet, meeting minutes and the SECOP public portal. On the left, the connected-sources panel shows nine labelled icons: databases, public web portals, materialised views, file servers, SharePoint, OneDrive, office documents, videos and audio. A map below places Search on the Auth IAM and LakeHouse base and shows that its information feeds ChatGen and the Dashboards.

g.text: How many contracts did we sign with IT suppliers in 2025?
In 2025, we signed 48 contracts with IT suppliers, totalling
$12.4 billion. Licensing and support account for 62%;
development and consulting make up the rest.
with knowledge for ChatGen and dashboards.
